item.title: The blind mole-rat has no visible eyes and squeals like a wheezing pig
item.dc:creator: Popkin
item.description:

item.title: Alaskan surfers ride the freezing bore tide waves of Turnagain Arm
item.dc:creator: Popkin
item.description:
The Turnagain Arm is a long body of water near Anchorage, Alaska. It is famous for its bore tides. A bore tide happens when a narrow body of water is met with a tide. Waves that travel as fast as 15 mph and reach up to 10 feet can happen. — Read the rest

item.dc:creator: Mark Frauenfelder

Built on a gently sloping hillside, the Nanzoin Temple is a sprawling Buddhist center that boasts the largest bronze reclining Buddha statue in the world. — Read the rest
